lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A vertical column of approximately four large, high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible immediately posterior to the gill slits, with a secondary horizontal row of three clusters extending along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible on the mid-lateral flank, intersecting with horizontal spot patterns to form a localized grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition with high luminance values on the dorsal aspect and lower luminance (shadow) on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark vertical crease or indentation is visible on the lower flank, situated immediately posterior to the pectoral fin trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller-diameter high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more spaced clusters on the lateral flank.
